definition: A cognitive model is a model used in cognitive diagnosis research to represent cognitive processes or structure and compare that representation with observed data. Its quality is judged by how well it fits the data, and revising it can be difficult because qualitative changes may be biased and quantitative methods may show misfit without showing how to improve it.
